# FAX - the slowest social network

> FAX is a real thermal receipt printer connected to the internet at
> fax.pielka.sh. Anyone can write a short message or add a photo, and it
> prints on paper in the owner's flat a few seconds later. Every print is
> kept on a public wall.

## Pages

- [Write a message](https://fax.pielka.sh/): type on the receipt, or add a
  photo with the PHOTO key, then slide the paper off the top of the screen
- [Every print](https://fax.pielka.sh/prints): the wall of every message
  ever printed

## Facts

- A thermal receipt printer (58 mm paper, 384 dots wide) driven by an
  ESP32-S3, reachable from a public website
- Messages: up to 9 lines of 32 characters; bold, underline, white-on-black
- Photos: dithered to 1-bit in the browser before printing
- Free, no account, no app; rate-limited to a few prints per visitor
- The site confirms "printed" only once the physical printer has taken the
  job
- Source: https://github.com/michal-pielka/fax
